notes.title: Demo 0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A massive update to the demo is live. It includes the following changes:


Overall a lot of improvement to existing content, as well al added new content (items, techniques, enemies, areas, quests, improvements).
Added Ignis quest line (consists of 3 missions, 1 in each cycle, each comes with a new and unique area).
New 'energy' system: passive power-ups that are unlocked with main story progression. Only 1 of 7 can be active (with this, all planned gameplay systems have been implemented).
New 'shop' functionality (and added a shop in Trimvine).
Added new Ranged weapon class: Bow.
Rebalanced all stats and balance on items, passives, abilities.
It's now possible to run while using Guns while performing fast Basic Attacks.
Sounds are now proximity based.
Added 'scouting' functionality (zoom out the camera temporarily).
Removed small game stutters (the game no longer waits for sounds and music to be loaded).
Added the option to buy previously acquired weapons from Laura (at Regular grade).


Finishing this version took much longer than expected (due to a lot of revisions, reworks, upgrades and the much bigger size that the Ignis questline ended up being). As such, in order to have the official release ready within a sensible timeline (Q4 of 2025 or Q1 of 2026), from now on I'll aim for smaller-scale but more frequent updates. At the moment, version 0.5 is planned for early November 2024, and version 0.6 for early January 2025.

notes.title: Demo 0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A massive update to the demo is live. It includes the following changes:


New 'Mission Select' screen that shows currently available quests, areas to explore and activities
Added Time system. Game lasts for 3 cycles (the world is reset, player's level and knowledge is not). Each cycle lasts 51 weeks, and some mission are only available for a limited time.
New missions: 'Night Raid' (first mission, an introduction to game mechanics), 'Meeting with Laura' (short explanation of the game's goal and methods to accomplish it).
New area that can be explored without time passing: Trimvine. It contains large and small objectives that can be accomplished.
Passive Power-ups for all 7 Trees (for a total of 322 nodes to choose from, some of them disabled because relevant mechanics are not yet implemented, such as Burning or Stealth).
1 new Weapon Class: Polearm (and 3 new Polearms).
2 new Greatswords, 2 new Twin Blades, 2 new Guns, 2 new Gloves, 2 new Helmets, 2 new Armours, 2 new Boots, 2 new Consumables.
2 new Abilities and 2 new Stances.
2 new enemy types (1 boss, 1 regular).


Version 0.4 should be ready late 2023 / early 2024 and will include the 'Ignis' Main Quest, as well a lot more abilities, enemies and other stuff.

notes.title: Demo 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.2 of the demo is available for download. This includes the following changes:


Added a short 'Prologue' story section (accessible by selecting the 'New Game' button), includes optional Tutorial,
8 new items,
4 new abilities,
Skill Tree menu (and the 'Anima' Skill Tree),
Overview menu (check player stats, assign abilities to different slots),
Stances system (passive bonuses with unlockable upgrades, assigned to each weapon),
2 stances
4 new enemy types (1 boss, 1 elite, 2 regular),
New content (areas, items, abilities, stances, enemies) included in Survival Mode


Version 0.3 should be ready late July/early August, and will include much more story content (as well as new abilities, items, enemies and many other things).
